analysis.summaryJa: 目的語など知りたい部分を穴として捉え、その種類に合うwhat・who・which・whoseを選び、直接疑問ではWH＋助動詞＋主語＋動詞の順にする。画像の発掘レーンとINVERSION GATEは直接疑問の倒置を示し、I wonder what Mia foundの対比は埋込み疑問では平叙文語順を保つことを示している。
grammarPoints: 物の目的語はwhat、人の目的語はwhoで尋ねる
限定された候補にはwhich＋名詞を用いる
所有者を尋ねるwhoseは名詞の前に置ける
目的語を尋ねる直接wh疑問はWH＋do・does・did＋主語＋動詞原形
埋込みwh節では助動詞倒置をせず主語＋動詞の語順にする
visualEvidence: Mia found ___の穴をwhatで指定する発掘レーンが描かれる
INVERSION GATEがWH＋AUX＋S＋Vの直接疑問語順を示す
what・who・which・whoseが四種類の穴として例示される
I wonder what Mia foundが直接疑問との語順対比として載る
commonTraps: 目的語wh疑問でdo・does・didを入れず平叙文語順にする
didの後ろに過去形を残す
埋込みwh節でもwhat did Mia findのように倒置する

questions.prompt: ------- did the purchasing manager approve?
questions.translationJa: 購買部長は何を承認しましたか。
questions.explanationJa: approveの物の目的語を尋ねるためwhatを文頭に置き、didで倒置します。

questions.prompt: Who ------- Ms. Patel invite to the product launch?
questions.translationJa: パテルさんは製品発表会に誰を招待しましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 人の目的語whoを尋ねる過去の直接疑問なのでdid＋主語＋原形inviteです。

questions.prompt: Which proposal ------- the board select?
questions.translationJa: 取締役会はどの提案を選びましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 限定候補をwhich proposalで示し、過去の一般動詞をdid＋原形selectにします。

questions.prompt: ------- access card is this?
questions.translationJa: これは誰の入館証ですか。
questions.explanationJa: 所有者を尋ねるwhoseを名詞access cardの前に置きます。

questions.prompt: What does the maintenance plan -------?
questions.translationJa: 保守プランは何を対象にしていますか。
questions.explanationJa: doesが三単現を担うため本動詞は原形coverです。

questions.prompt: Who did you ------- for the interpretation service?
questions.translationJa: 通訳サービスについて誰に連絡しましたか。
questions.explanationJa: didの後ろでは過去形ではなく原形contactを使います。

questions.prompt: Which delivery window do customers ------- most often?
questions.translationJa: 顧客はどの配達時間帯を最もよく選びますか。
questions.explanationJa: doが疑問形を作るので動詞は原形chooseです。

questions.prompt: I wonder what the technician ------- during the inspection.
questions.translationJa: 技術者が点検中に何を見つけたのか気になります。
questions.explanationJa: 埋込みwh節は平叙文語順what the technician foundにし、did倒置をしません。

questions.prompt: Could you tell me which room the client -------?
questions.translationJa: 顧客がどの部屋を予約したか教えていただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: tell meに続く埋込み疑問ではwhich room＋主語＋動詞の順にします。

questions.prompt: Do you know whose laptop this -------?
questions.translationJa: これが誰のノートパソコンか知っていますか。
questions.explanationJa: 埋込み疑問whose laptop this isでは主語thisがbe動詞isの前に来ます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct direct question asking about an object.
questions.translationJa: アシスタントは何を印刷しましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 直接の目的語疑問ではWhat did＋主語＋原形printの順にします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question asking which person Mr. Lee called.
questions.translationJa: リーさんは誰に電話しましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 目的語whoを文頭に置き、過去の疑問をdid＋主語＋原形callで作ります。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question selecting one of three plans.

choices.A: Which plan your team does prefer?
choices.B: Which plan does your team prefers?
choices.C: Which plan does your team prefer?

questions.translationJa: 3つのプランのうち、チームはどれを好みますか。
questions.explanationJa: which planを一まとまりで前に出し、doesの後は原形preferです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question about ownership.

choices.A: Whose coat is on the chair?
choices.B: Who's coat is on the chair?
choices.C: Who coat is on the chair?
choices.D: Whose is coat on the chair?

questions.translationJa: 椅子の上にあるコートは誰のものですか。
questions.explanationJa: 所有を表すwhoseを名詞coatの前に置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct embedded question after “Do you remember ...?”

choices.A: Do you remember what did the customer order?
choices.B: Do you remember what the customer did ordered?
choices.C: Do you remember did the customer order what?
choices.D: Do you remember what the customer ordered?

questions.translationJa: 顧客が何を注文したか覚えていますか。
questions.explanationJa: 埋込みwh節ではwhatの後をthe customer orderedという平叙文語順にします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct direct question about a chosen venue.
questions.translationJa: 彼らはどの会場を選びましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 直接疑問なのでdidを主語の前に置き、後ろは原形chooseです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question asking about a recipient.

choices.A: Who you did send the invoice to?
choices.B: Who did you send the invoice to?
choices.C: Who did you sent the invoice to?
choices.D: Who was you send the invoice to?

questions.translationJa: 請求書を誰に送りましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 人の目的語whoを文頭に出し、did＋主語＋原形sendとします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct embedded question about a selected color.

choices.A: Please tell me which color did Ms. Diaz select.
choices.B: Please tell me which color Ms. Diaz did selected.
choices.C: Please tell me did Ms. Diaz select which color.
choices.D: Please tell me which color Ms. Diaz selected.

questions.translationJa: ディアスさんがどの色を選んだか教えてください。
questions.explanationJa: 埋込み節ではwhich colorの後に主語Ms. Diazと動詞selectedを通常順に置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question about the contents of a package.
questions.translationJa: この荷物には何が入っていますか。
questions.explanationJa: 目的語whatの直接疑問ではdoes＋主語＋原形containです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct embedded ownership question.

choices.A: I need to know whose signature this is.
choices.B: I need to know whose signature is this.
choices.C: I need to know who's signature this is.
choices.D: I need to know whose this signature does.

questions.translationJa: これが誰の署名なのか知る必要があります。
questions.explanationJa: 埋込み疑問はwhose signature＋主語this＋be動詞isの平叙文語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “What did the auditor request?”

choices.A: The speaker asks for the thing requested by the auditor.
choices.B: The speaker asks who hired the auditor.
choices.C: The auditor requests an explanation of time.
choices.D: The speaker asks where the auditor works.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は監査人が求めた物・内容を尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: whatがrequestの目的語の穴を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “Who did Ms. Evans recommend?”

choices.A: The speaker asks why Ms. Evans made a recommendation.
choices.B: Ms. Evans has not recommended anyone.
choices.C: The speaker asks for the person receiving Ms. Evans’s recommendation.
choices.D: The speaker asks who recommended Ms. Evans.

questions.translationJa: 話し手はエバンスさんが推薦した人物を尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: whoはrecommendの目的語で、推薦した人ではなく推薦された人を求めます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “Which model did the client purchase?”

choices.A: The client designed a new model.
choices.B: The speaker asks the listener to identify the purchased model from known choices.
choices.C: The speaker asks the price of every model.
choices.D: The client purchased all available models.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は既知の候補から顧客が購入した機種を特定するよう求めています。
questions.explanationJa: which modelは限られた機種の中の選択を尋ねます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “Whose desk is this?”

choices.A: The speaker asks who built every desk.
choices.B: The speaker wants to know who owns or uses the desk.
choices.D: The speaker asks which desk is largest.

questions.translationJa: 話し手はその机の持ち主・使用者を尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: whose deskは机と所有者の関係を求めます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “I wonder what the manager decided.”

choices.A: The speaker is curious about the manager’s decision.
choices.B: The speaker directly asks the manager to decide now.
choices.C: The manager has refused to make decisions.
choices.D: The speaker knows exactly what was decided.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は部長が何を決めたのか気にしています。
questions.explanationJa: I wonderに続くwhat節が決定内容という情報の穴を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “Which supplier does the company use?”

choices.A: The company uses every supplier equally.
choices.B: The speaker asks for the company’s supplier among possible choices.
choices.C: The speaker asks when supplies will arrive.
choices.D: The supplier asks which company to use.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は候補の中で会社が利用する仕入先を尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: which supplierが限定選択を示し、supplierはuseの目的語です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “Can you tell me who the visitor met?”

choices.A: The speaker asks who met the visitor at this moment.
choices.B: The visitor refuses to meet anyone.
choices.C: The speaker asks where the meeting occurred.
choices.D: The speaker politely asks for the identity of the person the visitor met.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は来訪者が会った相手を丁寧に尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: whoはmetの目的語で、埋込み節はthe visitor metの語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “Do you know which file she opened?”

choices.A: The speaker asks why she closed a file.
choices.C: She asks the speaker to create a file.
choices.D: The speaker asks whether the listener can identify the file she opened.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は彼女が開いたファイルを相手が特定できるか尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: which file以下はknowの目的語となる埋込み疑問です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “What does the warranty exclude?”

choices.B: The speaker asks which items are outside the warranty coverage.
choices.C: The speaker asks when the warranty expires.
choices.D: The warranty has already been extended.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は保証の対象外となる物を尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: whatがexcludeの目的語となり、除外対象を求めます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “I’m not sure whose bag that is.”

choices.A: The speaker is uncertain about the bag’s owner.
choices.B: The bag definitely belongs to the speaker.
choices.C: The speaker does not know what the bag contains.
choices.D: The speaker asks which bag is heavier.

questions.translationJa: 話し手はそのバッグの持ち主が分かりません。
questions.explanationJa: whose bagが所有者という不足情報を示します。

questions.prompt: The receipt gives a total of $240, but the item name is unreadable. ------- did the customer buy?
questions.translationJa: レシートの合計は240ドルですが品名が読めません。顧客は何を買いましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 物の目的語が欠けているためwhatを使います。

questions.prompt: Three conference rooms are available. ------- room would you prefer?
questions.translationJa: 会議室は3室空いています。どの部屋がよいですか。
questions.explanationJa: 三つの既知の選択肢から選ぶのでwhich roomです。

questions.prompt: The visitor log shows that Ms. Green met someone at 2:00. ------- did she meet?
questions.translationJa: 来訪記録ではグリーンさんが2時に誰かと会っています。誰に会いましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 人の目的語を尋ねるwhoとdid＋she＋原形meetを使います。

questions.prompt: A jacket was found in Meeting Room 6. ------- jacket is it?
questions.translationJa: 第6会議室で上着が見つかりました。誰の上着ですか。
questions.explanationJa: 所有者を尋ねるwhoseを名詞jacketの前に置きます。

questions.prompt: I can see that a service was canceled, but not its name. What service did the customer -------?
questions.translationJa: サービスが解約されたことは分かりますが名称が不明です。顧客はどのサービスを解約しましたか。
questions.explanationJa: didが過去を担うので後ろは原形cancelです。

questions.prompt: The sales team selected one sample from this tray. Do you know which sample they -------?
questions.translationJa: 営業チームはこのトレーからサンプルを1つ選びました。どれを選んだか知っていますか。
questions.explanationJa: 埋込み疑問ではthey selectedという平叙文語順にします。

questions.prompt: The booking shows a room number but no guest name. Who did the receptionist ------- to Room 412?
questions.translationJa: 予約には部屋番号がありますが宿泊客名がありません。受付は誰を412号室に割り当てましたか。
questions.explanationJa: didの後ろには動詞原形assignを置きます。

questions.prompt: Two shipping methods cost the same. ------- method did the buyer choose?
questions.translationJa: 2つの配送方法は同じ料金です。購入者はどちらを選びましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 限られた二つの方法からの選択なのでwhich methodを使います。

questions.prompt: The help desk says the technician replaced a component. I wonder what he -------.
questions.translationJa: ヘルプデスクによると技術者が部品を交換しました。何を交換したのか気になります。
questions.explanationJa: wonderの後の埋込みwh節ではhe replacedと通常語順にします。

questions.prompt: The form has an unsigned approval box. Could you tell me whose signature it -------?
questions.translationJa: 書類の承認欄に署名がありません。誰の署名が必要か教えていただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: 埋込み疑問ではwhose signature＋主語it＋動詞requiresの順です。
